findings.title: Startup acceptance check counts the comment it requires
findings.trigger: An executor runs the prescribed startup-sweep acceptance check after implementing the required comment.
findings.execution_path: The sed range includes the new sweep comment. Line 142 instructs the executor to document that get_enabled_instances must not be used, while line 154 counts every occurrence without excluding comments.
findings.consequence: A correct implementation cannot satisfy the stated zero-count acceptance criterion, causing a false verification failure.
findings.evidence: The exact prescribed command prints 1 at the inspected head. The occurrence is in the comment; the configured set correctly iterates all configured instances.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude comment lines before counting, or check the configured-set expression structurally so documentation cannot fail the gate.
findings.reproduction_command: sed -n '/await ensure_cutover_recorded/,/Create long-lived clients/p' triggarr/search/scheduler.py | grep -c "get_enabled_instances"

limitations: Pytest was not rerun in the read-only sandbox; test execution evidence comes from the supplied exact-head harness report.
No live browser or real Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr integration exercise was performed.
Runtime cancellation and fault scenarios were assessed through implementation tracing and regression-test inspection.
